context: 2 DOSAGE AND ADMINISTRATION 3 DOSAGE FORMS AND STRENGTHS XENAZINE tablets are available in the following strengths and packages: The 12.5 mg XENAZINE tablets are white, cylindrical, biplanar tablets with beveled edges, non-scored, embossed on one side with “CL” and “12.5.” The 25

mg XENAZINE tablets are white, cylindrical, biplanar tablets with beveled edges, non-scored, embossed on one side with “CL” and “12.5.” The 25 mg XENAZINE tablets are yellowish-buff, cylindrical, biplanar tablets with beveled edges, scored, embossed on one side with “CL” and “25.”
